name: The partners
overview: The series is a romance-mystery and action-comedy drama that revolves around two female investigators with entirely contrasting personalities. Forced to work together as an unlikely investigation duo, they must look past their differences, constant bickering, and clashes in methodology to solve complex corporate and criminal cases.As they deep-dive into dangerous assignments, undercover operations, and hidden conspiracies, their professional friction begins to melt away. The high-stakes environment and shared vulnerabilities slowly blur the lines between professional partners and romantic feelings, forcing them to navigate an intense enemies-to-lovers dynamic while fighting to uncover the truth.
